study_identification_part.si4_title: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.answer: ENIGMA CHR-P multi-site structural MRI dataset
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: 29 international sites; 1,579 CHR-P and 1,243 HC; structural MRI processed with FreeSurfer and ENIGMA protocol
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P dataset amalgamated clinical and neuroimaging data from 29 sites, comprising 1579 individuals... and 1243 HC participants."

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.answer: ENIGMA CHR-P structural MRI used for heterogeneity analyses and normative PBSI reference
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Used to compare variability between CHR-P and HC with variability ratio/CV metrics and to compute PBSI deviations where HC profiles served as the normative reference; single pooled dataset (no explicit train/validation split)
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The respective neuroanatomical profiles of each CHR-P individual were correlated with the corresponding profiles of the members of the HC group... The resulting PBSI scores thus represent the degree of deviation from the 'normative' range"

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.answer: 1,243 healthy controls; no separate training split reported
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: Model: structural | Phase: overall | 1,243 HC; Model: structural | Phase: train | NR (single pooled dataset, no split described)
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.supporting_text: "Following quality control procedures... 1579 CHR-P participants... and 1243 HC participants across 29 sites"

dc4_age_info.answer: Mean HC age 22.32 years (SD 4.96); other statistics not reported; no train split
dc4_age_info.detail: Model: structural | Phase: overall | mean 22.32; sd 4.96; median NR; iqr NR; min NR; max NR; Model: structural | Phase: train | NR (no train split reported)
